subject.title: Add Message Rate Limiting for Feishu Channel

question: Should OpenClaw accept a Feishu-owned, default-off `sendRateLimit.minIntervalMs` config contract for proactive per-target outbound pacing?
rationale: The source-level gap is clear, but adding a new operator config key and deciding the live-proof bar for Feishu delivery timing needs maintainer product/API intent.

options.title: Accept default-off Feishu pacing
options.body: Review https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/96513 toward a default-off per-account/per-target `sendRateLimit.minIntervalMs` setting across burstable Feishu sends.

options.title: Keep only reactive retry
options.body: Reject the new config surface and document that OpenClaw relies on the existing Feishu retry/backoff path after rate-limit responses.

options.title: Move scope to broader limiter
options.body: Defer Feishu-specific pacing and make https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/13615 own any cross-provider queueing or rate-limit policy instead.

recommendation.title: Accept default-off Feishu pacing
recommendation.body: Review https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/96513 toward a default-off per-account/per-target `sendRateLimit.minIntervalMs` setting across burstable Feishu sends.

likelyOwner.reason: The Feishu plugin metadata names this handle as the community-maintained plugin owner candidate for Feishu-owned send behavior.
